sources.name: Caravan: A global community dataset for large-sample hydrology

variables.name: streamflow

variables.name: streamflow_volumetric

variables.name: hydroatlas_attributes
variables.description: Comprehensive catchment physiographic, climatic, land cover, and soil properties

sources.access_method: Zenodo Archive Download (Direct HTTP or zenodo-get / curl)

sources.name: India Water Resources Information System (India-WRIS) / Central Water Commission (CWC)
sources.organization: Central Water Commission, Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India
sources.spatial_coverage: Major Indian river basins (Ganga, Brahmaputra, Godavari, Krishna, Mahanadi, Narmada, Tapi, Cauvery)
sources.temporal_resolution: Daily / Hourly telemetry during monsoon season (June to October)
sources.date_range_current: Variable historical archives (typically 1970–present for gauge sites)

variables.name: water_level_m
variables.description: River stage / water level above mean sea level

variables.name: warning_danger_level_m
variables.description: Station flood thresholds (Warning Level, Danger Level, Highest Flood Level)

sources.access_method: India-WRIS Web GIS Portal / Open Government Data Platform (data.gov.in)
sources.license: National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP) - Open access for unclassified basins
